name: Answering Echo
desc: Calls your own voice back from the trees, very faintly. It barely stirs the air.

name: Vartari Stitch
desc: Sews a liar's lips shut with his brother's awl, as he did Loki's. Lowers the target's attack.

name: Riverbank Sumo
desc: Challenges you to sumo and hurls you into the river. An Ice/Water throw.

name: Look Behind You!
desc: Points past your shoulder and flashes his gold while you look. Lowers the target's accuracy.

name: Floodspout
desc: Gargles a gutterful of Seine floodwater over every foe. Ice/Water damage to all.

name: Sweet Puck's Luck
desc: 'Call me sweet Puck and you shall have good luck.' Heals the whole party a little.

name: Fatal Glance
desc: Its look kills, if you meet its eye. Heavy dark damage to one foe, but it may miss.

name: Bunbuku Teakettle
desc: Turns into a teakettle, gets put on the fire and leaps out scalding. Fire damage to one foe.

name: Gobble You Up
desc: 'Now I'm coming to gobble you up!' Bites a foe and drains HP.

name: The Devil's Coal
desc: Hurls the one live coal the Devil threw him at Hell's gate. Heavy fire damage to one foe.

name: Ferryman's Toll
desc: No fare, no crossing: he takes his obol with the oar. Dark damage; drains HP.

name: Liar's Thunder
desc: Swears the lightning will strike somewhere else. It doesn't. Electric damage to all foes; lowers their accuracy.

name: Chosen for the Slain
desc: Marks a foe for death with her shining spear. Lowers the target's defense.

name: Net of Lemnos
desc: Throws the unbreakable net he forged to catch Ares. Physical damage; the target is tangled (accuracy and evasion down).

name: Oni ni Kanabō
desc: An oni with an iron club, as the saying goes: the strong made stronger. A huge swing at one foe that can miss.

name: Run Amok
desc: Nobody stilled it before the Sabbath: 3-4 blind blows at random foes.

name: Phobos and Deimos
desc: His sons Fear and Terror strike beside him: two hits that lower the target's attack.

name: Unseen Orchestra
desc: Trumpets blare from nowhere, never quite on time: 2-4 wind blasts at random foes.

name: The Keening
desc: She keens for those about to die. Dark damage to all foes, and their strength fails (attack down).

name: Weighing of the Heart
desc: Weighs a foe's heart against the feather of Ma'at. Almighty: no resistance helps.

name: Charge of Asterion
desc: Bellowing, the bull charges blind through the labyrinth and gores every foe in the way.

name: Oberon's Horn
desc: Blows his ivory horn and every foe must dance. Greatly lowers their accuracy and evasion.

name: Bronze Embrace
desc: Slams into a foe and clasps him to his red-hot bronze chest. Heavy fire damage.

name: Pillar Breaker
desc: A raging headbutt like the one that broke Mount Buzhou, and the floods pour after. Ice/Water damage; lowers the target's defense, but often misses.

name: Spoken into Being
desc: He thinks it in his heart and says it with his tongue: a fallen ally lives again (usually) at half HP.

name: Týr's Pledge
desc: Strikes with the nerve that put his hand in the wolf's jaws. Enormous damage that rarely misses.

name: Lokasenna
desc: As at Ægir's feast, he finds everyone's sore spot. Dark damage to all foes; lowers their defense.

name: Hel Keeps Her Own
desc: Her half-dead hand takes, and Hel keeps what she has. Dark damage; drains HP.

name: Bull, Man and Ram
desc: Each of his three heads breathes fire: three fire hits on one foe.

name: World Coil
desc: The serpent that circles the world tightens his coils. Crushes every foe.
